facts.business: Essar Shipping Limited operates in the offshore drilling and shipping sector, providing oilfield services including drilling rigs and related marine logistics.

auditor.name: Manohar Chowdhry & Associates
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on: 1) Netting off ₹331.26 crore payable to wholly owned overseas subsidiary pending regulatory approval; 2) Exceptional gain of ₹606.28 crore including reversal of impairment and exchange gain; 3) Payment of ₹67 crore as guarantor for subsidiary's OTS; 4) Notice from SFIO seeking information; 5) Material uncertainty related to going concern due to accumulated losses of ₹5,968.03 crore and negative net worth.

key_risks: Material uncertainty related to going concern due to accumulated losses and negative net worth
Dependence on offshore drilling market cycles and rig utilization rates
Regulatory approvals pending for netting off intercompany balances
Ongoing investigation by Serious Fraud Investigation Office (SFIO)
Guarantor obligations for subsidiary debt settlements
facts.related_party_note: Netted off ₹331.26 crore payable to wholly owned overseas subsidiary against receivable, pending regulatory approval; paid ₹67 crore as guarantor for subsidiary's one-time settlement; recognized exceptional gain of ₹606.28 crore including reversal of impairment on loan to subsidiary and exchange gain on recovery.
